about_the_game:
Little Ghosties is a cozy idle pet sim where tiny ghosts live on your desktop. Inside a magical globe, your ghosts will hatch, grow, and play as they press a mysterious button that generates currency.

You can interact with your ghosts at any time, keeping them happy with food, toys, and cute accessories. The happier they are, the more they will press the button! Or, let them chill out and nap while you work or browse. 

You can exchange ghost pellets for new eggs to hatch even more ghosts. Raise them from tiny wisps to fully grown ghosts, and discover rare ghost types. Your ultimate goal? Hatch and raise every ghost, unlock every accessory, and expand to new islands as you build the happiest, spookiest little family.

The game’s clean, minimal UI fades away when you’re not interacting, so you can keep your ghost globe floating on your screen. It’s the perfect cozy companion while you work, study, or relax.

Features

  • 🐣 Hatch and raise ghosts – Grow them through three life stages: Egg → Wisp → Juvenile → Fully Grown.

  • 👻 Collect them all – Discover both common and rare ghost types, each with their own adorable designs.

  • 🧪 Ectoplasm economy – Collect Ghost Pellets in exchange for new ghost eggs.

  • 🎮 Play actively or let it run idle – Keep your ghosts happy to gain more currency, or let them play on their own while you work or chill.

  • 🎩 Dress them up! – Buy fun cosmetic accessories to make each ghost unique.

  • 🌍 Unlock new islands – To match your mood.

  • 🪟 Lives on your desktop – A magical globe that you can move and resize anywhere on your screen, blending seamlessly with your workspace.

  • 🌙 Cozy, spooky vibes – Soft, muted tones and a calming aesthetic create a relaxing atmosphere.
